x: The outstanding performances in the handicaps were those of A. Kench in the 880 yards, and of a newcomer, F.

Once again Croydon won the 4 x 300 yards and it must be stated that their quartette at this distance are very warm and would beat most teams over this relay. This time, however, we had a "dust-up" with Mitcham for second place and with F.
Johns following up his win by now securing second place, and F.
While clearing out family papers, the son of Frank Stower came across Belgrave items saved for many years by his late father – and has passed them on to us.
